name: round6_other_tasks
success_at_end_required_for: PickCube-v1 (success requires the arm to be still)
configs: derived from the teammate's three-task config with the same per-task 200-trajectory subsets (subset_rng_seed preserved) and repointed demo paths

preregistered.primary: per task, V1 vs B0 run-level success, 4 vs 4, exact permutation (70 permutations; smallest attainable two-sided p = 2/70 = 0.029)
preregistered.decision: supported iff p < 0.05 and mean difference > 0; effect size reported either way
preregistered.multiplicity: two tasks tested, so whether each survives alpha = 0.025 is also stated
preregistered.cut_order: PullCubeTool to 3+3 (descriptive only), then drop PullCubeTool; PickCube stays at 4+4 if at all possible
